# Changelog

## 0.1.0 — 2026-11-16
- First version: links, embeds and the file explorer open the listed file types (default `cdx, cdxml, mnova, pdf`) in the folder set in the settings (default `Files`, with its subfolders; the same types elsewhere still ask) in their program with one click, without Obsidian 1.15's question "Open file in another app?". Programs, scripts, pages, SVG, Office files with macros and disk images are refused in the list; Obsidian still asks before running anything executable.
